llm.relevance_to_user: 该论文直接针对增材制造Ti-6Al-4V合金的疲劳寿命预测，与您的AM疲劳研究方向高度相关。
llm.why_not_core: This paper focuses on fatigue life prediction using deep learning, but does not address implant design, stress shielding, or osseointegration.

summary_zh.motivation: 利用3D CNN融合多模态数据预测增材制造钛合金疲劳寿命
summary_zh.method: 构建3D卷积神经网络整合多种数据模态进行疲劳寿命预测
summary_zh.result: 实现了高精度疲劳寿命预测
summary_zh.validation: 通过增材制造Ti-6Al-4V疲劳实验验证

summary_en.motivation: To improve fatigue life prediction for additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V using multi-modal data fusion.
summary_en.method: A 3D convolutional neural network integrates multiple data modalities for fatigue life prediction.
summary_en.result: The model achieves high accuracy in fatigue life prediction.
summary_en.validation: Validated with fatigue experiments on additively manufactured Ti-6Al-4V alloy.
